_comment: ALT-R&B progressions with per-chord qualities. Chord progressions are freely copyable -- see ../../docs/idiom-research/legal.md. Harmonic families from ../../docs/idiom-research/genre-funk-soul-rnb.md section C2: the i-bVI-bVII loop, the dorian i9-IV9 vamp, the lush two-chord Imaj9 oscillation, ii-V with borrowed colour, and the backdoor bVII to Imaj7. Everything moves at 2 bars per chord to match altrnb/material.json chords.barsPerChord, and every chord carries a seventh -- section C8 lists plain triads and plain V7 as the genre error, so V is written as sus4 (a 13sus in practice) or replaced by bVII7.
